purpose: silver_runways is the cleaned, one-row-per-runway reference table built from the OurAirports runways extract, carrying surface, dimension, lighting, closure, and per-end geolocation detail for each runway so it can be joined to the airports silver table and used in airport infrastructure and routing-capacity analyses.
usage: Join to airports on airport_identifier (matching the published ident) for human-facing joins or on airport_reference for the integer key; treat is_lighted and is_closed as booleans, and because low_end_/high_end_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold columns are independently nullable (roughly 22-28% null for geolocation/heading and 88-90% null for displaced thresholds), consumers must null-check before computing per-end metrics rather than assuming both ends are populated.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the source's incomplete surveys: le_/he_ latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns remain null on about 22-28% of rows and displaced_threshold_feet columns on 88-90% of rows; surface_code and the low_end_/high_end_ identifier columns were left as free text because the publisher's own dictionary states these vocabularies are open-ended and irregular samples (e.g. '.', '-', '-12') could not be normalized without inventing a taxonomy.
